introduction.description:
Formed in 2021 by six players: Nakahara Masato, Kawasaki Manami, Fujisaki Kenta, Noguchi Arata, Matsubara Akane, and Suga Kosuke.
A unique ensemble whose members all perform independently, without belonging to any traditional school.

Beyond the folk songs at the heart of Tsugaru shamisen, the group performs original pieces with modern rhythms and harmonies, exploring new possibilities for the Tsugaru shamisen ensemble.

contact.requestBody:
We perform at parties, ceremonies, festivals, and other events.
The program and performance length can be flexibly arranged to suit your event.
contact.requestFirstStep: Please feel free to contact us using the form below or by email and tell us about the event you have in mind.
contact.songsBody: We perform a wide range of music, including traditional folk songs, contemporary pieces, and covers. The program can be tailored to your event.
contact.priceBase:
Full ensemble of 6 players
30 minutes: from ¥200,000 (tax included)
contact.priceExtra: An additional fee applies if you would like us to perform in traditional Japanese attire. Travel expenses are charged separately.
contact.priceSmallGroup: Depending on the size of the venue, your budget, and the atmosphere you are looking for, we can also perform as a smaller group of 2 to 5 players.
contact.priceProposal: After hearing your requests, we will propose the best plan for your event. Please feel free to contact us.
contact.priceDisclaimer: * Prices shown are a guide only. Fees may vary depending on the program, time commitment, and venue location.

items.q: What kinds of events can we book you for?
items.a: We perform at a wide range of events, including parties, ceremonies, festivals, school performances, and concerts.

items.q: How far in advance should we book?
items.a: Because scheduling and other arrangements are required, we recommend contacting us about three months in advance. We may also be able to accommodate last-minute requests, so please feel free to ask.
We mainly perform in and around the Kanto region, but we are happy to discuss events anywhere in Japan. Travel expenses are charged separately.
Performances typically last about 30 minutes to 1 hour. Short performances of around 15 minutes or two-part programs are also available upon request.

items.q: Can we choose or request songs?
items.a:
We can perform a wide variety of pieces, including traditional folk songs, contemporary pieces, and covers. Please consult us about the program for your event.
Requested songs may also be possible if we are given time to prepare. Depending on the song, an additional fee may apply for arrangement and other preparation.

items.q: How many performers can you send?
items.a: We perform with 2 to 6 members. Please consult us based on the size of the venue, your budget, and the atmosphere you would like.
Yes, we can perform in kimono. An additional fee applies.

For a 6-member, 30-minute performance, the guideline price is ¥200,000 or more (tax included). The fee may vary depending on the program, the length of the engagement, the venue location, and other factors.

items.q: How and when should we pay?
items.a: We do not have fixed rules for the payment method or timing. These are decided through individual consultation based on your request.
Your booking is confirmed once you accept our quotation. If you cancel for your own reasons after confirmation, the following cancellation fees apply.

head: Timing of cancellation (counted from the performance date)
Cancellation fee

items.note:
* Cancellation fees are based on the performance fee only (excluding the kimono surcharge and travel expenses).
* If the event is canceled or postponed due to unavoidable circumstances such as weather or natural disasters, we will discuss the arrangements with you individually.

items.q: Do we need sound equipment (microphones and speakers)?
items.a: Depending on the size and environment of the venue, sound equipment such as microphones and speakers may be required. If the venue does not have such equipment, we will consider options with you, so please feel free to contact us.
Yes, we also perform outdoors. However, performing may be difficult depending on the weather and the venue environment. Please consult us in advance about arrangements in case of rain.

items.q: Do we need to prepare anything at the venue (chairs, a dressing room, etc.)?
items.a: We would appreciate it if you could provide a chair for each performer and a dressing room for changing and preparation. If anything is difficult to arrange, please let us know in advance.

items.q: May we photograph or stream the performance?
items.a: Taking photos and videos is generally fine. However, please consult us in advance about live streaming or publishing videos online so that we can confirm the conditions.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Tsugaru Shamisen Tsudoi ("we" or "us") handles personal information received through this website (tsudoi-shamisen.com) as follows. This English version is provided for reference; if there is any difference, the Japanese version prevails.

sections.title: 1. Operator
sections.body:
Tsugaru Shamisen Tsudoi
Contact: tsudoi.shamisen@gmail.com
We will provide the name of our representative and our address without delay upon request.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
items: Information entered in the contact form (name, company or organization, email address, phone number, event date and venue, details of your request, etc.)
Your email address and message when you contact us by email
Website usage data for analytics (pages viewed, type of device and browser, etc.), collected using cookies

sections.title: 3. Purposes of Use
items: To answer inquiries and to contact you and provide quotes regarding performance requests
To understand and improve how the website is used

sections.title: 4. Disclosure to Third Parties
sections.body: Except as permitted by law, such as when required by laws and regulations, we do not provide personal data to third parties without your consent. For providers located outside Japan, see "5. External Services" below.

sections.title: 5. External Services
sections.body: This website uses the following external services. All are provided by companies in the United States, and information is stored and processed outside Japan, including in the United States.
items: Formspree (Formspree, Inc., United States): used to send the contact form. Your entries reach our email address via Formspree's servers. We ask for your consent to this when you submit the form. Formspree's privacy policy: https://formspree.io/legal/privacy-policy/

Google Analytics (Google LLC, United States): used to understand how the website is used. It collects browsing data using cookies, but this does not include information that directly identifies you, such as your name, and we do not link it with your inquiries. For how Google uses this data, see "How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services" (https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites?hl=en ). To opt out, use the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on (https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout?hl=en ).
YouTube (Google LLC, United States): used to play videos on the home page. Videos are loaded only when you press the play button.

For the personal information protection system of the United States, see the page of Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission (https://www.ppc.go.jp/enforcement/infoprovision/laws/offshore_report_america/ , in Japanese).

sections.title: 6. Retention and Deletion
sections.body: We keep the contents of inquiries for three years from our last exchange and then delete them.

sections.title: 7. Security Measures
sections.body: To prevent the leakage of personal information, we take the following measures.
items: We have appointed a person responsible for the handling of personal data.
Devices used to handle personal information have antivirus software installed.

Understanding the external environment: inquiries are stored in an email service provided by a U.S. company (Google LLC). We take security measures based on an understanding of the personal information protection system of the United States.

sections.title: 8. Requests for Disclosure, Correction, Deletion, etc.
sections.body: If you wish us to notify you of the purposes of use, disclose, correct, add to, or delete your personal information, stop using or erase it, or stop providing it to third parties, please email us at the contact address above. After confirming your identity, we will respond without delay. No fee is charged.

sections.title: 9. Inquiries and Complaints
sections.body: Please send any inquiries or complaints regarding the handling of personal information to the contact address above.

sections.title: 10. Revisions
sections.body: We may revise this policy in response to changes in laws and regulations or for other reasons. Any revisions will be announced on this page.
